reply.text: That sounds frightening, and it needs a doctor, not a coach. A heart racing at that rate for half an hour while you're sitting still is something to get checked now, so please call your doctor or emergency services, or go to the nearest emergency room, rather than waiting it out. If you feel chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, faintness or weakness, call emergency services immediately. Once a medical professional has cleared you, I'll work around whatever they tell you and keep the training side moving.
